changes: Added dev_memory_capture/list/search/preflight/finish/start commands, file-backed project/global/story-candidate JSONL storage, non-authoritative schema markers, command ownership policy entries, docs, and regression coverage for reviewer evidence classification in REVIEW to TEST gates.
usage: Use node packages/main/dist/cli.js dev_memory_capture to save lessons, dev_memory_preflight before the next coding session, dev_memory_start for prompt-only startup guidance, and dev_memory_finish at session end. After merge these are available through koala dev_memory_* commands.
expectedOutcome: A normal coding session outside Koala can preserve workflow lessons and later retrieve them before coding, without creating a story or satisfying any Koala gate evidence.
actualTranscript: See .koala/story/actives/B-ad2c/evidence/transcript-diff.md: in a fresh temporary directory, dev_memory_list started empty, dev_memory_capture saved bf1e7cc, list/search/preflight/start returned the lesson, and dev_memory_finish retained project memory without requiring story directories.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible gap. Actual output matched expected behavior. Only caveat: in-flight self-hosted verification used node packages/main/dist/cli.js because global koala still points at main until merge.
limitations: Global koala may lag a story worktree during Koala self-development; current-worktree verification must use node packages/main/dist/cli.js until the story is merged. Dev-memory remains non-authoritative and cannot satisfy gates by design.
pitfalls: Two reviewer-gate regressions were found while finishing: main-agent findings were initially treated as reviewer evidence, then the legacy guard-utils mirror still needed the shared koala-review-* classifier. Also verify_codex needed packages/utils build artifacts before recording the Codex adapter process-event.
